content: REQUIRED DOCUMENTATION FOR MOBILE APP: 1. PRD (iOS/Android variants). 2. UI/UX Mobile Design System (HIG/Material 3). 3. Platform Architecture (MVVM/MVI). 4. API Contracts. 5. Local Storage & Sync Strategy. 6. Cross-Platform Strategy. 7. Mobile Threat Model. 8. Mobile DFDs. 9. Privacy Policy. 10. App Store Submission Guidelines. 11. CI/CD. 12. App Security (pinning, jailbreak detection). 13. DR & Fallback. 14. Incident Response. 15. Runbooks. 16. Audit Reports. 17. Dependency Analysis.
